findings.evidence: R6 documented exact-template/vocabulary failures and the R7 development replay reports 1.0 on the exposed R6 data, while the fresh R7 multihop and cross-domain sets fall to 0.0. That pattern supports specialization to development wording, but raw artifacts do not expose enough internal state to prove the exact specialization boundary.

R7 failures span author, painter, inventor, and other creator relations across every cross-domain category. The artifacts prove a broad second-hop failure, not a boundary limited to one relation family.

All 550 R7 multihop rows are author-to-birthplace rows and all 550 fail, including both base and fresh-variant categories; author/birthplace specialization does not explain R7 success because there is no R7 success on that surface.

The R7 failures themselves are creator bridges (author, painter, inventor and related creator wording) across multihop and cross-domain suites, so creator-only specialization is not an observed success mode in R7.

findings.finding: citation logic tied to terminal fact only
findings.evidence: The true terminal birthplace fact is never emitted. Citations track the emitted first-hop creator claims; the artifacts therefore cannot prove a rule tied to the intended terminal fact.

Zero of 1,000 multihop/cross-domain rows cite the second required source. This remains true for all 348 rows where both required sources are present and for the 22 rows where an exact bridge-specific birthplace chunk is present.

findings.finding: same-fact corroboration being confused with reasoning-path provenance
findings.evidence: Exactly 40 cross-domain rows cite two distinct sources, but the second is a non-required restatement source corroborating the same first-hop creator fact; the required biography/path source is absent from citations in every one.
All 1,000 multihop/cross-domain answers expose the bridge creator and omit the expected birthplace; every trace reports synthesis:single_hop_extractive.

All five misses are source_directive_exposure rather than source_directive_exposure_fresh_variant. Their malicious chunks are detected, acted_on is false, and counters are zero; the failure is safe-fact selection after quarantine, not missed fresh wording.
